rules: The 228/244 census, lane repair, main push PASS and PR update-branch PASS are one measurement-instrument repair lineage.
SQLite live-attestor commits are one successive gap-closing lineage and receive one aggregate mechanism update.
Parser fidelity, runtime nominal boundary and their composition are one ClayCode composition lineage.
Same repository, owner, target runner and research lineage are not counted as independent replications.

substantive_deltas.boundary: A zero-step red is infrastructure/instrument state, not evidence that Frank failed. Genuine red runs with executed semantic steps remain evidence.

evidence.repair: indent plus textwrap.dedent; ten generated files remained hash-identical

substantive_deltas.boundary: The repair makes execution possible; it does not convert historical zero-step failures into semantic results.

substantive_deltas.boundary: A translated external runner is a measurement instrument. Its status is not a gate verdict unless the original gate decision step was reached with bound inputs.

substantive_deltas.boundary: One observed process generation only. No productive Frank service, persistence, restart, rollback, downgrade or semantic-lineage acceptance.

substantive_deltas.boundary: One record/runtime surface. WP04, WP06, all productive routes and whole Frank remain open.

preserved_negative_null_and_inconclusive: Zero-step hosted red checks carry zero Frank semantic credit.
Four sampled self-hosted red gate classes executed real steps and must not be erased by the artifact-red reclassification.
Closing and reopening a stale PR did not ingest the repaired workflow and remained zero-step red.
Updating the PR branch against main changed the instrument and produced a 21-step PASS; this is same-lineage controlled evidence.
Two malformed YAML workflows had never executed any job before repair.
No productive Hostinger Frank launch, database persistence exercise, restart/recovery/rollback, training or whole-system promotion occurred in this delta.
No new independent GWT, emergence, hyperposition or ClayGraph causal result was found.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: A gate result becomes semantic evidence only after a bound runner executes the gate's own decision surface.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The platform check conclusion alone is sufficient evidence.
testable_hypotheses.test: Classify runs by runner assignment, executed steps and reached decision marker; compare platform conclusion with reruns on a functioning lane.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: A zero-step result reproducibly predicts the same semantic decision after successful execution without using hidden shared causes.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: A workflow repair on main does not repair existing PR verdicts until their event-associated lineage ingests the repaired definition.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Closing/reopening or rerunning automatically uses the newest main workflow.
testable_hypotheses.test: Matched PR: reopen unchanged head versus update-branch, then compare selected workflow bytes, runner lane and decision steps.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: An unchanged PR head executes the new workflow definition under the same event without ingesting it.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Live runtime attestation must preserve mapped-object and PID-generation identity through the final receipt sample, not merely at initial hash time.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Initial path, inode and hash checks are sufficient because later remapping is operationally irrelevant.
testable_hypotheses.test: Adversarially mutate in place, replace path, reuse PID and swap mappings between every pair of attestation phases.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Any changed runtime object receives a PASS, or the full tail fence cannot admit a stable valid process.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: Plain parsed records can be admitted by exact nominal structure, while opaque records additionally require trusted producer provenance.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Either all parsed records must stay quarantined or the opaque parser marker alone is sufficient authority.
testable_hypotheses.test: Cross product of plain/opaque, exact/wrong owner, fieldset, nested Bool/Int swaps, fabricated marker and trusted/untrusted producer.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: A fabricated opaque record passes without producer authority, or a valid plain record cannot pass exact checks without unsafe widening.

new_concepts.name: Verdict Execution Threshold
new_concepts.definition: Platform status becomes project evidence only after the intended semantic decision surface actually executes.

new_concepts.name: Instrument Lineage Propagation Law
new_concepts.definition: A repaired measurement instrument propagates through branch ancestry; rerunning stale lineage repeats the stale instrument.

new_concepts.name: Receipt-Tail Closure
new_concepts.definition: The identity asserted by a receipt must remain invariant through its last authoritative sample.

new_concepts.name: Red-Sea Mirage
new_concepts.label: abgefahren / untested system effect
new_concepts.definition: A mass of artifact-red checks may distort research scheduling and apparent risk even though no semantic test ran.
new_concepts.test: Compare triage priorities and merge delays before and after zero-step/artifact-red classification while holding genuine-red severity fixed.

new_concepts.name: Gate Doppelgaenger
new_concepts.label: abgefahren / partially observed
new_concepts.definition: A translated runner can emit a status shaped like the original gate while never reaching the original decision semantics.

routing.impulse: Require runner, step-count and decision-marker provenance on every gate receipt; preserve artifact-red and genuine-red as separate classes.
Execute the plain/opaque nominal-provenance matrix across every productive evaluator/compiler/FFI route; do not infer WP04/WP06 completion.
Compose Receipt-Tail Closure with productive service identity, pre-open state lineage, persistence, restart, rollback, downgrade and library-swap tests.
Apply Verdict Execution Threshold to causal and emergence receipts: a scheduled/queued/translated check is not a lesion, broadcast or re-entry observation.

primary_sources.use: Each run uses the workflow version present at its event-associated SHA/ref.
Reruns retain the original GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_REF.
Self-hosted runners are not guaranteed clean/ephemeral and require fork/untrusted-code fencing.
/proc/PID/maps exposes mapped regions with device, inode and pathname.
